final_content: Desarrollar un nuevo control remoto original
content_en: Develop a new, original remote control.

final_object: Precio de venta del control remoto
final_content: Se establece un precio de venta objetivo de 25 euros
content_en: A target selling price of 25 euros is set.

final_content: Se decide orientar el control remoto hacia el mercado internacional
content_en: It is decided to aim the remote control at the international market.

final_content: El control remoto se utilizará exclusivamente para el televisor
content_en: The remote control will be used exclusively for the television.

final_content: Se decide que el control remoto debe ser atractivo
content_en: It is decided that the remote control must be attractive.

final_content: Se decide que el control tenga buena forma ergonómica
content_en: It is decided that the remote should have a good ergonomic shape.

final_content: Se decide que el control remoto tenga tamaño equilibrado
content_en: It is decided that the remote control should have a balanced size.

final_content: Se decide enfocar el producto hacia el público joven incorporando nuevas tecnologías
content_en: It is decided to target the product at young people, incorporating new technologies.

final_object: Mecanismo de navegación del control remoto
final_content: Se adopta el uso de una rueda para la navegación y cambio de canales
content_en: The use of a wheel for navigation and channel changing is adopted.

final_content: Se decide descartar el uso de tecnologías de reconocimiento
content_en: It is decided to rule out the use of recognition technologies.

final_content: Se decide que el logotipo corporativo y los colores de la empresa deben identificarse claramente en el producto
content_en: It is decided that the corporate logo and company colors must be clearly identifiable on the product.

final_object: Descarte de tecnologías LCD y ASR
final_content: Se ratifica el descarte definitivo tanto de la pantalla LCD como del reconocimiento automático de voz (ASR)
content_en: The definitive discarding of both the LCD screen and automatic speech recognition (ASR) is confirmed.

final_content: El control remoto dispondrá de una estación base independiente
content_en: The remote control will have a separate base station.

final_content: Habrá un botón en la estación base para localizar el control remoto cuando se extravíe
content_en: There will be a button on the base station to locate the remote control when it is lost.

final_content: Se decide incorporar dos ruedas de desplazamiento: una para canales y otra para volumen
content_en: It is decided to include two scroll wheels: one for channels and one for volume.

final_content: Se incluye un botón turbo en el control remoto
content_en: A turbo button is included on the remote control.

final_content: Habrá un botón de encendido y apagado para el televisor
content_en: There will be an on/off button for the television.

final_object: Forma del control remoto y estación base
final_content: Se decide dar forma de banana al control remoto y diseñar la estación base con aspecto de hoja de plátano
object_en: shape of the remote control and base station
content_en: It is decided to give the remote control a banana shape and to design the base station to look like a banana leaf.

final_object: Disposición de las ruedas de desplazamiento
final_content: Se decide ubicar la rueda de volumen en el lado izquierdo y la rueda de canales en el lado derecho del control
content_en: It is decided to place the volume wheel on the left side and the channel wheel on the right side of the remote.

final_content: Se decide incorporar un botón de teletexto que activa su visualización y permite utilizar las ruedas para navegarlo
content_en: It is decided to include a teletext button that activates its display and allows the wheels to be used to navigate it.

final_object: Ubicación del puerto infrarrojo y botón de localización
final_content: Se decide ubicar el puerto infrarrojo en la parte superior del control y el botón de localización en el frontal de la estación base
object_en: location of the infrared port and locator button
content_en: It is decided to place the infrared port on the top of the remote and the locator button on the front of the base station.

final_object: Peso y color del control remoto
final_content: Se decide que el control tenga un peso similar al de una banana real pero con un tono amarillo especial para diferenciarlo
object_en: weight and color of the remote control
content_en: It is decided that the remote should weigh about as much as a real banana, but with a special yellow shade to set it apart.

final_content: Se decide fabricar el control remoto en plástico
content_en: It is decided to make the remote control out of plastic.

final_content: Se establece que el control remoto dispondrá de tres botones pulsadores
content_en: It is established that the remote control will have three push buttons.

final_object: Fuente de energía y sistema de carga
final_content: Se eliminan las celdas solares y se adopta el uso de baterías recargables
content_en: The solar cells are removed and the use of rechargeable batteries is adopted.

final_content: Se decide utilizar un chip estándar o regular en lugar de uno avanzado por motivos de costo
content_en: It is decided to use a standard or regular chip instead of an advanced one for cost reasons.

final_content: Se decide que el control remoto tendrá curvatura simple en lugar de doble curvatura
content_en: It is decided that the remote control will have a single curvature instead of a double curvature.
